::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Noida-headquartered, with offices in Bengaluru and San Diego; founded in 2023 by Chitranjan (Chitu) Singh, founder, CEO and chief architect. Said in May 2024 it was working with telecom OEMs to supply chips for BSNL's planned 5G network. Its website says Gen 1 5G small-cell connectivity silicon has been in production since 2026 and Gen 2 (connectivity plus perception on one die) was committed to tape-out in July 2026, with OEM sampling targeted for H2 2027. The production claim is self-reported. Reported in Sept 2026 to be seeking about $5 million.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Deterministic RISC-V/DSP compute and 5G small-cell connectivity chips, with a perception (edge-AI) SoC on the same architecture.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 4/5:** Domain difficulty 4: 5G small-cell baseband/L1 plus RISC-V/DSP compute; hard but not RF/mmWave front-end.
- **IP ownership 4/5:** IP ownership 4: claims in-house deterministic RISC-V/DSP architecture, L1 software and IP, 'developed and owned in India'.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** Design completeness 3: company says Gen 1 silicon in production; no independent confirmation of tape-out or silicon.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** Market readiness 2: OEM partnerships for BSNL 5G reported in 2024; no named customers or shipments.
